# Orvio 0.36

- Security: account e-mail links are only accepted for a sign-up or password reset you started on this device, for that same address. Another app or web page can no longer sign Orvio into a different account.
- Security: after five wrong profile PINs Orvio waits 30 seconds before the next try, and longer after that.
- The start-up animation plays again every time you open Orvio, also right after closing it.
- Live TV no longer starts a channel by itself: phones open the provider's categories first, and on TV the remote starts in the category list.
- Phones: channel numbers of four digits or more stay on one line, and an empty Live TV player says "Choose a channel to start watching".
